p: right in the sight of the: Although they of Judah were given to idolatry and impiety, as they of Israel were, yet God for the sake of his promise was merciful to the throne of David, and yet by his judgment toward the other, provoked to repentance.

Nehushtan: That is "a piece of brass": thus he calls the serpent by contempt, which even though it was set up by the word of God, and miracles were wrought by it, when it was used for idolatry this good king destroyed it, not thinking it worthy to be called a serpent, but a piece of brass.
from the tower of the watchmen: Read 2Ki 17:9.
I have offended: As his zeal was before praised, so his weakness is here set forth, that no one should glory in himself.
Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from: After certain years, when Hezekiah ceased to send the tribute appointed by the king of the Assyrians, he sent his captains and army against him.
counsel and strength for the war: You think that words will serve to persuade your people, or to move my master.
Egypt: Egypt will not only be unable to help you, but will be a detriment to you.
taken away: Thus the idolaters think that God's religion is destroyed, when superstition and idolatry are reformed.
pledges to my lord the king: Meaning, that it was best for him to yield to the king of Assyria because his power was so small that he did not have men to care for two thousand horses.

LORD against this place to destroy: The wicked always flatter themselves in their prosperity, that God favours them. Thus he speaks to scare Hezekiah into thinking that by resisting him he would be resisting God.
I come and take you away: He makes himself so sure, that he will not grant them a truce, unless they give themselves to him to be led away as captives.
LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of: This is an execrable blasphemy against the true God, to make him equal with the idols of other nations: therefore God sharply punished him.
